classification_contract: Every baseline site is classified by the per-path counts below. Adapter conversions preserve the prior bound-owner result set. The one remaining workspace-metadata expression is an exact-source named exception in owner_query_inventory.py because it combines direct team ownership with the legacy flattened metadata-owner representation; no conversion changes behavior in this branch.

result_set_contracts.personal_only: The supplied session identity remains the owner and no team predicate is added.
result_set_contracts.team_capable_null_or_empty: Team requests match team_id; personal requests match session_id with a NULL or empty team_id.
result_set_contracts.exact_session_and_team: Recent-value operations continue to match both the supplied session identity and the exact team-id value, including the empty personal value.
result_set_contracts.token_keyed: Secret-vault rows continue to match the exact flattened vault-scope id stored in session_token, whether that id represents a personal session or a team.
result_set_contracts.composite_key: Secret, variable, starred-command, and retention mutations keep their exact legacy owner plus record-key predicates.
result_set_contracts.named_exception: Team workspace metadata keeps matching either its direct team_id or its legacy flattened session_id = team_id representation until Phase 3B.

coverage.list_detail: Session preferences, variables, recent values, stars, workflow definitions and executions, secret metadata and values, and workspace-file metadata.
coverage.mutation: Secret upsert, delete, and rewrap; variable and star removal; recent-value pruning; workspace metadata delete and move.
coverage.import_export: Session migration copies or re-keys workflow, preference, variable, recent-value, and secret records without changing owner semantics.
coverage.cleanup_retention: Recent-value retention and source-row cleanup retain exact composite owner keys.
coverage.worker: Workflow actor-limit reads and worker secret lookup continue to use the legacy session or flattened vault-scope owner.
